description: Used in sge_execd to keep track of all processes on the machine.

attributes.name: utime
description: Number of jiffies that this process has been scheduled in user mode.

attributes.name: stime
description: Number of jiffies that this process has been scheduled in kernel mode.

attributes.name: rss
description: Resident Set Size (physical memory) in bytes.

attributes.name: groups
description: GR list with all groups associated with this process.

attributes.name: rel
description: Flag if this process belongs to a GE job.

attributes.name: run
description: Flag if this process is still running.

attributes.name: io
description: IO characters for the running process.

attributes.name: ioops
description: IO operations for the running process.

attributes.name: iow
description: IO wait time in clock ticks for the running process.
